sections.title: About this notice
items: This notice explains how Lead71 by Vision71, a product of Vision71 Technologies, handles information when it is used to scan and review business cards
This notice applies to Lead71 as a standard product and covers all Vision71 customers who use it
If your organisation has a separate written agreement with Vision71 that sets out different terms for your use of Lead71, that agreement applies alongside this notice

sections.title: What Lead71 does
items: A signed in user photographs or uploads a business card
The card image is sent to Vision71's backend so the text on it can be read automatically
The extracted name, job title, company, email, phone number and other details are shown to the user to review and correct
A reviewer confirms the contact before it is kept or passed on

sections.title: Information Lead71 processes
items: The image of the business card
The text automatically read from that image
The contact details confirmed after review, such as name, job title, company, email, phone number and any notes
The name of the person who captured, reviewed or approved a record, and when this happened

sections.title: Where information is processed and stored
items: Lead71 is hosted on Vercel, a cloud hosting provider
Card records are kept in central storage on approved secure cloud infrastructure, not only in the browser being used
Each record is encrypted before it is stored, and records for one customer are kept separate from another customer's records
A card image is kept only for the length of time agreed with the customer, after which it is deleted automatically

sections.title: Who else receives information
items: Google Cloud Vision, used to read the text on the card
If Google Cloud Vision cannot read a card, no other reading service is used unless the customer has separately approved it. The user can capture the card again or enter the details manually
Vercel, which hosts Lead71 and handles the upload and the reply from the reading service
Where a customer approves it, an agreed contact system such as Constant Contact, used only to receive an approved contact
No card image or contact detail is sent to any other company

sections.title: How information travels
items: Information sent between the browser and Lead71's backend, and between Lead71 and the services named above, travels over an encrypted connection

sections.title: Access to information
items: Each person who uses Lead71 signs in with their own named account, shared logins are not used
A person can only see and act on the information their role allows

Vision71 support access will be limited to authorised technical personnel, only where necessary to resolve an issue, for a limited period and with an activity record. It will not include routine access to Aventure contact records or business card images

sections.title: How long information is kept
items: A card image is kept only for the period agreed with the customer, then deleted automatically
Confirmed contact details are kept for as long as the customer needs them for the purpose they were collected for
A person can ask for a specific record to be deleted earlier

sections.title: Your choices
items: Ask for an individual saved record to be deleted
Ask for a copy of the information held about a specific contact
Choose not to proceed with saving a scanned card after reviewing it

sections.title: Security
items: Information is encrypted while it travels between the browser, Vision71's backend and the services named above
Stored records are also encrypted
Access is limited by named accounts and by role
Every review, approval, transfer and deletion is recorded in an internal record of activity

sections.title: Changes to this notice
items: Vision71 may update this notice as Lead71 changes. An updated version will be published with a new date

sections.title: Contact us
items: Questions about this notice can be sent to Vision71 Technologies, contact details to be confirmed on the published version

sections.title: About these terms
items: These terms apply to anyone using Lead71 by Vision71, a product of Vision71 Technologies
By using Lead71 a user agrees to these terms
A customer with a separate signed agreement with Vision71 is also bound by that agreement. Where the two conflict, the signed agreement applies

sections.title: What Lead71 is
items: Lead71 is a tool for scanning a business card, reading its text automatically, and letting an authorised user review and correct the details before they are kept
Lead71 is a working product that continues to be developed and improved

sections.title: Individual user accounts
items: Lead71 is used through a named account belonging to one person, shared logins are not permitted
A customer's administrator is responsible for creating accounts for their own team and removing access when someone leaves or no longer needs it
A person must keep their sign in details private and tell their administrator if they believe their account has been misused

sections.title: Using Lead71 responsibly
items: Only scan a business card that the user is authorised to collect and use
Check and correct the details Lead71 extracts before relying on them. Automatic reading can make mistakes
Do not use Lead71 to collect information there is no right to hold
Do not share an account or sign in details with anyone else
Do not attempt to disrupt, overload or gain unauthorised access to Lead71 or its backend

sections.title: Accuracy of extracted information
items: Lead71 uses automated text reading services to extract details from a card image
Extracted details may contain errors, especially on unclear, damaged or unusually designed cards
The user is responsible for reviewing and correcting extracted details before relying on them

sections.title: Ownership
items: Lead71, including its design, source code, and branding, is the property of Vision71 Technologies
A customer's business card images and contact details remain that customer's own information at all times
Using Lead71 does not transfer ownership of Lead71 to a customer, and does not give Vision71 ownership of a customer's information

sections.title: Availability
items: Vision71 aims to keep Lead71 available but does not guarantee uninterrupted access
Lead71 may be updated, changed or temporarily unavailable without notice as it continues to be developed

sections.title: No warranty
items: Lead71 is provided as it is, without a guarantee that it will be free of errors or interruptions
Vision71 does not guarantee that extracted contact details will be complete or accurate

sections.title: Support boundaries
items: Vision71 support covers keeping Lead71 running and fixing faults in the product itself
Vision71 support does not include entering, correcting or reviewing a customer's contact details on their behalf, unless separately agreed

Vision71 support access will be limited to authorised technical personnel, only where necessary to resolve an issue, for a limited period and with an activity record. It will not include routine access to Aventure contact records or business card images

sections.title: Limitation of liability
items: To the extent allowed by law, Vision71 is not responsible for losses arising from use of Lead71, including losses from inaccurate extracted details
Nothing in these terms limits liability where the law does not allow it to be limited

sections.title: Changes to these terms
items: Vision71 may update these terms as Lead71 develops
Continued use of Lead71 after an update means the updated terms apply

sections.title: Ending use
items: A customer's administrator may remove a user's access at any time
Vision71 may suspend or end a user's access to Lead71 for a breach of these terms

sections.title: Governing law
items: The law that governs these terms is to be confirmed and stated on the final published version, following review by Vision71's legal advisor

sections.title: Contact us
items: Questions about these terms can be sent to Vision71 Technologies, contact details to be confirmed on the published version
